sources.title: Long Eddy River Access
observations: Public Upper Delaware River access at 10 Ferry Street, Long Eddy, New York, near river mile 315.
Owned/managed by New York DEC; non-motorized boats only; gravel boat ramp available.
Parking lot is gravel and can accommodate approximately 10 vehicles with trailers.
sources.use: Primary confirmation that the named Long Eddy launch is public and usable for non-motorized boats; it gives a street address rather than a GPS toe coordinate.

sources.title: Long Eddy public access, Delaware River Water Trail
observations: Names Long Eddy public access at river mile 315.6.
Describes a gravel ramp and cartop/non-motorized launch.
sources.use: Coordinate source, corroborated by NPS's current public-access site description and NPS dataset. The point is retained as an access-site anchor, not claimed as a surveyed toe.

sources.title: Satellite imagery at the Water Trail Long Eddy point
sources.observation: The published point sits within the Ferry Street / Railroad Street access corridor near the mapped Long Eddy Access label and the Delaware River. Imagery supports the access-area location but does not resolve the gravel-ramp toe.
